export const PLAYER_MAX_HP = 400
export const PLAYER_MAX_STAMINA = 100
export const PLAYER_MAX_POISE = 40
export const STAMINA_REGEN = 25
export const STAMINA_REGEN_DELAY = 0.6
export const SPRINT_COST = 12
export const POISE_DECAY = 15
export const FLASK_MAX = 3
export const FLASK_HEAL = 180
export const WALK_SPEED = 4
export const SPRINT_SPEED = 6.5
export const GUARD_SPEED = 2

export type Vitals = {
  hp: number
  maxHp: number
  stamina: number
  maxStamina: number
  poise: number
  maxPoise: number
  regenDelay: number
}

export function createVitals(maxHp: number, maxStamina: number, maxPoise: number): Vitals {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: createVitals(${maxHp},${maxStamina},${maxPoise})`)
}

export function createPlayerVitals(): Vitals {
  throw new Error('não implementado: createPlayerVitals')
}

export function canAct(v: Vitals): boolean {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: canAct(${v.stamina})`)
}

export function spendStamina(v: Vitals, cost: number): Vitals {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: spendStamina(${v.stamina},${cost})`)
}

export function regen(v: Vitals, dt: number, allow: boolean): Vitals {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: regen(${v.stamina},${dt},${allow})`)
}

export function takeDamage(v: Vitals, damage: number, poiseDamage: number): { vitals: Vitals; broke: boolean } {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: takeDamage(${v.hp},${damage},${poiseDamage})`)
}

export function heal(v: Vitals, amount: number): Vitals {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: heal(${v.hp},${amount})`)
}
